name: Vanta Modifier
description: Provides a Modifiers plugin that sets an animated Vanta.js background on an element.
project_description:
Back to top 

 Overview 
 This module is an addition to set of Modifiers which provides animated backgrounds for your components.

 It is using Vanta.js 3rd party library which allows you to set nice animated backgrounds. See examples at Vanta.js .

 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 This module requires Modifiers module, Paragraphs module and Vanta.js library.

 Back to top 

 Installation 
 
 The module can be installed via the

 [standard Drupal installation process]( http://drupal.org/node/1897420 ) 
 It will create a new Paragraph bundle 
 Reference this Paragraph bundle from an Entity Reference Revisions field with machine name field_modifiers which you also need to add on an entity (Block or

 Paragraph) or onto a field on a Look 
 Install required library 
 
 Library installation (manual) 
 
 Download Vanta.js library

 (version 0.5.21 is recommended). 
 Place unpacked library in your libraries folder. 
 
 or you can install library via Composer. See README.md for more information.

 Back to top 

 Maintainers 
 These modules are maintained by developers at Morpht. For more information on the company and our offerings, see morpht.com .
